name: yankooliveira/uiframework
description: The deVoid UI Framework for Unity providing a flexible UI architecture with navigation history, transition animations, input blocking, and priority-based layering enforcing strict separation of concerns.
score_rationale: Well-architected Unity UI navigation framework with 622 stars, but last updated 2019 making it partially outdated for modern Unity versions.
summary: Flexible UI architecture with navigation history and animations
